name: ACE_ENGINE_URL
label: Playback engine address
help: Leave empty to use the bundled engine when enabled. Saved Settings → Playback takes precedence.

name: ACE_CHECK_ENGINE_URL
label: Dedicated checking engine address
help: External checker only. The bundled checker uses its own internal address; otherwise leave empty for playback-engine checks.

name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
label: Public address
help: Address players use to reach this app. Saved Integrations → Public address takes precedence.

name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_SCRAPE_TARGETS
label: Allow sources on private networks
help: Turn off when private-network sources are not needed. Metadata endpoints always remain blocked.

name: TUNER_ALLOWED_NETWORKS
label: Networks allowed to use tuner routes
help: Tuner routes do not use the API token. * allows every network.

name: FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS
label: Trusted reverse proxies
help: Use only actual proxy addresses. With no proxy, leave 127.0.0.1. Trusting the whole home network prevents local casting from identifying direct clients.

name: CORS_ORIGINS
label: Allowed browser origins
help: Comma-separated origins, or a JSON array. Usually only needed for separate frontend hosting.

name: ENABLE_ACESTREAM_ENGINE
label: Bundled playback engine
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_ACESTREAM_CHECK_ENGINE
label: Bundled checking engine
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_ACEXY
label: Acexy
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_IPFS
label: IPFS
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_ZERONET
label: ZeroNet
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_TOR
label: Tor for ZeroNet
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_WARP
label: WARP
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ACESTREAM_BIND_ALL
label: Allow remote engine clients
help: The engine API has no authentication. Publish its port only on trusted networks.

name: WARP_ENABLE_NAT
label: Connect WARP before starting engines
help: Requires NET_ADMIN, SYS_ADMIN and /dev/net/tun in Docker. No routing changes until explicitly enabled.

name: EPG_PROGRAM_RETENTION_HOURS
label: Guide retention (hours)
help: Any negative value keeps expired programmes.

name: TZ
label: Timezone
help: Container timezone, for example Europe/Madrid. Restart to apply.

name: ACESTREAM_HTTP_HOST
label: Bundled engine connection host
help: Address used inside the container. Usually localhost.

name: ACESTREAM_HTTP_PORT
label: Bundled engine HTTP port
help: Internal listening port. Update Docker port mappings if you publish it.

name: ACEXY_HOST
label: Acexy upstream host
help: Engine host reachable from inside this container.

name: ACEXY_PORT
label: Acexy upstream port
help: HTTP port of the engine Acexy connects to.

name: ACEXY_LISTEN_ADDR
label: Acexy listen address
help: Internal listener, such as :8084. Match any published Docker port to this port.

name: ACEXY_NO_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT
label: Acexy response timeout
help: Time to wait for an engine response, for example 10s or 1m30s.

name: ACEXY_BUFFER_SIZE
label: Acexy buffer size
help: Buffer per stream, for example 5MiB or 10MiB.

name: ZERONET_UI_PORT
label: ZeroNet UI port
help: Internal web UI port. Update Docker mappings if published.

name: ZERONET_FILESERVER_PORT
label: ZeroNet peer port
help: Internal peer port. Update Docker mappings if published.

name: ZERONET_UI_HOST
label: ZeroNet allowed UI hosts
help: Space-separated hostnames allowed to open the unauthenticated UI. Keep access on trusted networks.

name: IPFS_API_HOST
label: IPFS API bind address
help: Keep loopback unless trusted clients need the unauthenticated node API.

name: IPFS_API_PORT
label: IPFS API port
help: Internal node API port.

name: IPFS_GATEWAY_PORT
label: IPFS gateway port
help: Internal gateway port. Docker may publish a different host port.

name: IPFS_SWARM_PORT
label: IPFS peer port
help: Internal peer port. Match TCP and UDP Docker mappings if published.
